Conjugated Estrogens are known to bind to Slco1c1, which is involved in the transport of organic anions across cell membranes. This transporter activity is directly associated with Slc22a8, indicating a possible role in the transport of anions across cellular membranes. The integration of these pathways implies that Conjugated Estrogens may influence Slc22a8 through the regulation of Slco1c1, which in turn affects the activity of Slc22a8. This mechanism highlights a potential pathway by which Conjugated Estrogens could modulate the function of Slc22a8, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction and regulatory role.
